Spondylometaphyseal skeletal dysplasia with characteristic dental abnormalities; hearing loss and diabetes belong to a specific subtype.
Inherited thyroid hormone synthesis defect causing hypothyroidism and goiter; neurologic impairment has no established qualifying frequency.

Localized painful swelling of costal cartilage and costochondral joints; cardiac-like pain does not indicate heart involvement.

Disorder of binocular visual correspondence.
Intramuscular adipocytic tumour that infiltrates surrounding skeletal muscle.
Benign cutaneous lymphatic vessel proliferation producing persistent skin plaques.

Benign bone-forming tumour located in the middle ear.
Circadian sleep timing disorder affecting neurologic regulation of the sleep-wake cycle.
Defined as an ovarian or fallopian tube neoplasm; these reproductive sites have no axis, and endocrine dysfunction is not defining.
Named cutaneous keratinization disorder; no evidence supports additional organ involvement.
Orientia infection; HPO reports anterior uveitis and ischemic gangrene each in 30-79%. Rash is transient; renal, meningeal and myocardial complications are below 30%.
